title: orchestrate rbac seed and tenant-scoped roles automation
author: Priya Shah
description: Introduce an idempotent RBAC seed orchestrator that unifies Helm post-install hooks, Terraform tenant role provisioning, and an upgrade-safe rollback playbook for Private deployments. This PR adds a small controller and CLI that run as part of the private-installer lifecycle to create tenant-scoped roles, bind minimal bootstrap permissions, reconcile policy bundles, and garbage-collect stale role bindings across tenants. Motivation: reduce manual tenant onboarding steps, remove brittle ad-hoc scripts, and ensure upgrades do not leave partial RBAC state that can cause outages. The change supports both VPC and air-gapped on-prem installs and is written to be non-destructive by default. The description below summarizes the surface area and testing performed.
